registry.registered_before: engine/02_analyze.py was executed for the first time
registry.note: The full family below is registered before any result is computed. It is the family that the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control in gate G5 applies to. Thresholds are project-defined design choices, not official NFL or sportsbook policy.

price_source.note: THIRD-PARTY ARCHIVE. The NFL publishes no betting lines. Every price used in this project comes from this archive and is labelled third-party everywhere it appears. Official-only tables leave the price cells blank.
price_source.spread_convention: Determined empirically over 7,413 archive rows: the archive's spread_line equals the expected home margin, so the HOME team's line is -spread_line and the home team covers when actual_margin > spread_line. The competing reading gives a 59.2% home cover rate over the same rows against 47.6% for the adopted reading, and the adopted reading is the only one consistent with the archive's own moneyline signs.

betting_strategies.name: ATS edge (1.5 pp)
betting_strategies.rule: Bet the side with the larger model-versus-vig-removed-market cover probability, only when the edge is at least 1.5 percentage points.

betting_strategies.name: ATS edge (3.0 pp)
betting_strategies.rule: Same rule as S1 with a 3.0 percentage point edge floor.

betting_strategies.name: Total edge (2.0 pp)
betting_strategies.rule: Bet over or under the market total when the model over-probability differs from the vig-removed market over-probability by at least 2.0 percentage points.

betting_strategies.name: Moneyline edge (2.0 pp)
betting_strategies.rule: Bet the moneyline when the model win probability differs from the vig-removed market win probability by at least 2.0 percentage points.

betting_strategies.name: Favourite-only ATS
betting_strategies.rule: Bet the market favourite at the spread whenever the model also makes that side the favourite by at least 1 point.

betting_strategies.name: Small-line ATS
betting_strategies.rule: Bet the market favourite at the spread whenever the market line is 3.0 points or smaller and the model agrees the favourite should cover.

betting_strategies.name: 2-leg ATS parlay
betting_strategies.rule: Combine the two highest-edge S1 legs from two different games in the same week into a parlay priced at the product of the two decimal odds.

betting_strategies.name: 3-leg ATS parlay
betting_strategies.rule: Combine the three highest-edge S1 legs from three different games in the same week.

betting_strategies.name: ATS + total parlay
betting_strategies.rule: Combine the highest-edge S1 leg with the highest-edge S3 leg from two different games in the same week.

betting_strategies.name: Player prop combo (two players, different games)
betting_strategies.rule: No rule can be evaluated: no official player game log and no verifiable player prop price were found in any official source.

betting_strategies.name: Same-game player prop pair
betting_strategies.rule: No rule can be evaluated: no official player game log and no verifiable player prop price were found in any official source.

reward_policy.betting_board: A strategy earns reward points only if gates G1 to G9 all pass. Points = round(100 x t-statistic of the holdout ROI against the no-edge null), capped at 1,000 and floored at 0.
reward_policy.forecast_board: A forecast variant earns reward points only if G1, G6 and G9 pass. Points = round(50 x z), where z = (MAE of the naive baseline - MAE of the variant) divided by the standard error of the paired per-game difference, capped at 500 and floored at 0. This board needs no prices, so it can be paid even though the NFL publishes no betting lines.
reward_policy.currency: Points are non-monetary until the owner funds a pool. No pool is funded in this project; this is recorded as an open item for the owner.

G4.detail: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval for ROI

G6.detail: earlier forecasts changed when 422 holdout outcomes were perturbed: 0

G9.detail: The price-independent forecast skill of the model that selects the bets (the pre-registered V1 model) must beat the naive baseline on the holdout and must be non-negative in at least 2 of the 2023-2026 validation and holdout seasons. Holdout skill +0.5189 points of mean absolute error; non-negative in 4 of 4 seasons.

G7.detail: Every price comes from a recorded third-party archive with a commit SHA and a SHA-256 checksum, and every price column was audited for calibration before use. The NFL publishes no betting lines, so this gate can only be satisfied by a non-official source and every such row is labelled third-party. See data/price_determination.json.

G8.detail: ROI must beat the 95th percentile of 1000 skill-free peer strategies that place the same number of bets, and the peer false-positive rate must not exceed 10%

G5.detail: Benjamini-Hochberg q across the 7 evaluated strategies
